subject: bus
alt: Grade 11 learners following the HR recruitment and selection process from job posting to employment contract
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners showing a sequential HR process as a numbered flowchart: 1) Identify vacancy, 2) Advertise (internal/external), 3) Receive applications, 4) Shortlist, 5) Interview, 6) Select and appoint, 7) Sign contract. Use people icons at each step, connecting arrows, a split between internal and external paths at step 2, bright colours, simple flat design, clean white background, minimal text labels.

subject: bus
alt: Grade 11 learners seeing the induction process alongside salary determination methods and employee benefit types
prompt: Create a clear, flat friendly educational illustration for Grade 11 learners. On the left show an induction roadmap: welcome, orientation tour, meet team, training, performance review. On the right show salary determination factors as a scale/balance: market rates, job grading, BCEA minimums, experience. Below both show benefit icons: medical aid heart, pension piggy bank, leave calendar, bonus money bag. Use bright colours, simple flat design, clean white background, minimal text labels.
